LanguageData.LW_AllianceOfferText: An envoy from {ally} arrives: they are at war with {enemy} and offer you an alliance. Accept, and {ally} becomes a real ally (they help in fights and trade) — but {enemy} will become your enemy and raid you.
LanguageData.LW_RuinSiteLetterText: A {faction} settlement has fallen to ruin. Its remains lie abandoned nearby — send a caravan to clear them for salvage.
LanguageData.LW_RaidWarningWellArmed: This is a wealthy, well-armed faction — expect a hard-hitting raid.

LanguageData.LW_WorldWarDisabledByRimWar: Rim War is driving world factions; Living World's world war is paused.

LanguageData.LW_ConflictLetterText: Word arrives that {factionA} and {factionB} have gone to war. New conflicts this period: {count}.
LanguageData.LW_EmpireActiveNote: Empire manages your own empire; Living World tracks the NPC world's factions.
LanguageData.LW_InspectPopulationMissingLine: Living World population: no data for this settlement (ledger settlements: {settlements})
LanguageData.LW_Settings_BootstrapLedgerTip: When enabled, Living World builds its initial settlement population and resource ledger as the RimWorld world is created.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_DebugLoggingTip: Write Living World bootstrap summaries to the RimWorld log.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_WorldMapSpeedTestTip: When enabled, Living World can raise the real tick rate to the selected multiplier only while the global world map is selected. Paused, normal speed and colony maps are left unchanged.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_WorldWarEnabledTip: When on, NPC factions raid, scout, trade and wage war on each other. Automatically ceded to Rim War when it is active.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_TravelingRaids: Raids travel across the world map
LanguageData.LW_Settings_TravelingRaidsTip: When on, faction raids set out from the attacker's nearest settlement and march across the world map to your colony - you see the warband coming and get a warning - instead of appearing at the map edge. Turn off to have raids arrive instantly.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_EconomicDiversityTip: When on, each settlement gets a deterministic economic character (specialization and prosperity) from the world seed, so some factions are genuinely richer or better-armed than others. This is what makes wealth-driven events - tougher raids from rich factions, bigger trader silver, wealthy-faction warnings - actually vary. Turn off for a flat, uniform economy.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_MechClustersTip: When on, a couple of dormant mechanoid complexes appear on the world map. They are roused by your colony's wealth and their proximity, and mechanoid raids are attributed to the nearest one - so mech attacks have a visible cause instead of coming from nowhere. Turn off to leave mechanoid raids as vanilla.
LanguageData.LW_MechClusterDormant: Mechanoid complex - dormant. A derelict mechanoid site, inactive for now. It stirs as a nearby colony grows wealthy.
LanguageData.LW_MechClusterActive: Mechanoid complex - ACTIVE. Roused mechanoids are launching raids from here against your colony.
LanguageData.LW_MechClusterAwakenText: A dormant mechanoid complex has powered up, roused by your colony's growing wealth and its proximity. Expect mechanoid incursions from it - this is no random attack. Track it on the world map.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_ArrivalsTravel: Neutral groups travel across the world
LanguageData.LW_Settings_ArrivalsTravelTip: When on, faction visitors, trade caravans and travellers set out from one of their settlements and cross the world map to your colony - you see them coming - instead of appearing at the map edge. Turn off to have them arrive instantly. Orbital traders are unaffected.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_ArmoryMobilizationTip: When on, colonists work in civvies and arm up from the armory only when mobilized - manually via the Mobilize toggle, or automatically while enemies are on the map.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_AutoDraft: Auto-draft combat colonists on a raid
LanguageData.LW_Settings_AutoDraftTip: When on, combat-capable armed colonists are automatically woken and drafted while a real enemy is on the map, so they do not sleep or work through a raid. You still position them, and undrafting one sticks. Never triggers on the manual mobilize toggle.
LanguageData.LW_MobilizeTooltip: Toggle colony mobilization. When on, combat-capable colonists arm up from the armory racks; the colony also mobilizes automatically while enemies are on the map. Off returns them to work and civvies.
LanguageData.LW_AssignKitTooltip: Remember this colonist's current weapon and armour as their combat kit. On mobilization they will always take exactly this kit from the racks (if available) instead of a skill-based pick. Equip them as you want first, then assign.
LanguageData.LW_ClearKitTooltip: Forget this colonist's assigned kit. On mobilization they will take a skill-appropriate weapon and armour from the racks instead.
LanguageData.LW_ConfigureKitTooltip: Open a window to pick this colonist's exact mobilization weapon and armour pieces from what is stocked on the armory racks. Anything left unset is chosen automatically by skill.
LanguageData.LW_GroupApproachingText: A group of {kind} from {faction} has set out toward {colony}. They should reach you in about {days} day(s). Track them on the world map.
LanguageData.LW_Settings_CompatNoneActive: No conflicting mods detected. Living World drives the full NPC world.
LanguageData.LW_MissionMarkerInspect: {faction} {kind}: heading to {target} - arrives in about {days} day(s).
LanguageData.LW_MissionReason_Warband: military action ordered by its faction
LanguageData.LW_RaidApproachingText: A {faction} war party has set out across the world toward {colony}. They should reach you in about {days} day(s). Track them on the world map and prepare your defenses.
LanguageData.LW_InspectThreatLine: Under threat: a warband is inbound - arrives in about {days} day(s).
LanguageData.LW_DirectVisitObserverTooltip: Record a direct visit to this settlement and open its Living World ledger view. This reveals exact population, projects, animals and stores for this settlement only.
LanguageData.LW_WorldActionLegendLine: Visible markers: warbands {warbands}, caravans {caravans}, scouts {scouts}, diplomats {diplomats}. Click a marker on the world map to see faction, target, cargo/strength and reason.
LanguageData.LW_WorldActionSettlersImmediate: Settlers: expansion currently founds a new ledger settlement immediately; no fake travelling settler marker is drawn yet.
LanguageData.LW_SettlementObserver_DebugOnly: Exact settlement ledger inspection is available only when Living World debug logging is enabled. Use scouts, traders and direct visits for player-facing knowledge.

LanguageData.LW_WorldGenBlurb: Living World tracks every faction settlement as a living ledger of people and resources - they grow, migrate, trade and wage war even when you never see them. World size and population are set by the vanilla planet options above.
LanguageData.LW_WorldGenAdvancedHint: Fine-tuning (settlement sizes, economy, drifters) lives in Options - Mod Settings - Living World.
